working_definition: Esophageal epithelial cells of the foregut tube (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00003131 adult esophagus; broad class epithelial cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult esophagus epithelium (FBbt:00058279).

justification: Cell-level equivalent of the authors' organ term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Portion of the adult foregut that extends from the cibarium anteriorly, through the brain to the proventriculus posteriorly.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ term, not a cell term.
